source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
Signs that corn is ready to harvest:
- The leaf sheath around the ear has dried out.
- The husk has turned brown/dry, and the kernels are visible/exposed at the tip.
- The kernel base/silk attachment shows a dark coloring.
- Moisture content within the kernel is at about 25%.
- Corn should be harvested as soon as it reaches maturity, since delaying harvest exposes ears to weather damage, pests, and quality loss.
